meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: 装上后,你要求生成或修改图片时,Claude 会调用 OpenRouter 的图像模型(如 Gemini 3.1 Flash、FLUX.2 Pro)生成或编辑图片,并存为 PNG 文件。需要先配好 OpenRouter API 密钥。
howto.when: 当你需要生成或编辑照片、插画、概念图等非技术图表类图片时触发。若要画流程图、电路图等技术示意图,则改用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 生成一张夕阳下山的照片。
say.note: 会生成图片并保存为 PNG 文件。

say.text: 把这张图片的天空改成紫色。
say.note: 编辑模式需要配合图片输入路径使用。

say.text: 用 FLUX.2 Pro 画一只太空中的猫。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, when you ask to generate or modify an image, Claude uses OpenRouter's image models (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Flash, FLUX.2 Pro) to create or edit the image and saves it as a PNG file. An OpenRouter API key must be configured.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to generate or edit photos, illustrations, concept art, or other non-technical images. For flowcharts, circuit diagrams, or similar technical diagrams, the scientific-schematics skill is used instead.

say_en.text: Generate a photo of a sunset over the mountains.
say_en.note: Generates an image and saves it as PNG.

say_en.text: Change the sky in this image to purple.
say_en.note: Edit mode requires an input image path.

say_en.text: Draw a cat in space using FLUX.2 Pro.
